about.body1: A small business doesn't need an agency with a 40-slide deck. It needs a clear website that loads fast, looks professional, and turns visitors into clients.
about.body2: I build exactly that — no over-engineering, on time, with an honest price. You describe the task, I solve it.

curio-today.title: Curio Today
curio-today.description: A modern curation platform for digital discovery and thoughtful exploration of niche interests.
curio-today.problem: Digital noise makes it hard to find high-quality, curated content. Users are overwhelmed by algorithmic feeds that prioritize engagement over value.
curio-today.solution: I built a platform that focuses on human-curated collections, using a minimalist UI to reduce cognitive load and Framer Motion for a "tactile" digital experience.
